text: Under Armour is the brand of Under Armour, Inc., a US listed sportswear company (NYSE: UA, UAA) controlled by founder Kevin A. Plank: its July 2026 proxy statement shows him holding Class A and Class B stock carrying 64.6% of the combined voting power.
short: Under Armour, Inc. is a listed US company whose founder Kevin Plank holds 64.6% of voting power.
